profiles.name: Veldrassen
profiles.specialties: Heavy engineering, railway equipment and general manufactures; coal and processed fuel exports
profiles.constraints: Provincial consent slows concentration; major arsenals and railway junctions remain irreplaceable targets.
profiles.older_arts: Court examination offices and provincial registries preserve records; access varies by patron.

profiles.name: Ostrevain
profiles.specialties: Grain distribution, military stores and arsenal production
profiles.constraints: Mass manpower outstrips motor transport; imported precision machinery constrains arsenal expansion.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

profiles.name: Rovessara
profiles.specialties: Precision instruments, electrical apparatus and overseas commerce
profiles.constraints: Trade interruption threatens fuel and food imports; its skilled workforce is difficult to replace.
profiles.older_arts: Institutes and hospitals collect documented cases; evidence is better organised than practitioner supply.

profiles.name: Brannervaux
profiles.specialties: Water engineering, agricultural processing and industrial chemistry
profiles.constraints: Water allocation and estate vetoes complicate mobilisation; river freight is sensitive to damaged locks.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

profiles.name: Cervaud
profiles.specialties: Frontier logistics, armaments repair and estate agriculture
profiles.constraints: Arms and credit depend on competing patrons; prolonged mobilisation drains agricultural labour.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

profiles.name: Veylac
profiles.specialties: Metallurgy, machine tools and factory production
profiles.constraints: Exposed frontier factories and food imports limit a long war despite excellent machine-tool output.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

profiles.name: Ossavren successor territories
profiles.specialties: Competing provincial administrations, workshops and military supply; divided coalfields and petroleum districts
profiles.constraints: Combined rival returns; no common treasury, staff or army. Rail gauges, tolls and civil fighting fragment capacity.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

profiles.name: Rovengard
profiles.specialties: Valley agriculture, timber and stronghold supply
profiles.constraints: Winter supply and dispersed valley garrisons consume most available transport.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

profiles.name: Varnesk
profiles.specialties: Ore processing, specialist steels, bearings and durable machinery
profiles.constraints: Specialist foundries are strong; grain imports and seasonal routes make an extended blockade dangerous.
profiles.older_arts: Guarded workshops sometimes collaborate with rare practitioners; no standardised arcane production.

profiles.name: Galdresk
profiles.specialties: Field medicine, communications and scholarly traditions
profiles.constraints: Small arsenals and scattered teaching houses constrain scale; trained wardens excel locally rather than in mass campaigns.
profiles.older_arts: Small warden teaching houses preserve field traditions; skilled practitioners remain exceptionally rare.

profiles.name: Halskert
profiles.specialties: River freight, milling and agricultural exchange
profiles.constraints: Seasonal navigation and dependence on imported fuels limit sustained operations away from rivers.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

profiles.name: Tervayne
profiles.specialties: Maritime freight, ship maintenance and naval supply
profiles.constraints: Sea lanes carry its power; inland movement is slow and there is no through railway to eastern Vesalius.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

profiles.name: Vardol
profiles.specialties: Northern arsenals, estate production and military provisioning; coalfields and fuel refining
profiles.constraints: The Averholt frontier and northern garrisons tie down formations; large armies cannot simply redeploy to the Marches.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

profiles.name: Averholt
profiles.specialties: Basin agriculture, internal trade and provincial engineering
profiles.constraints: Provincial bargains and the Vardol frontier absorb resources; interior transport has limited spare capacity.
profiles.older_arts: Scattered practitioners and private records; no dependable standing magical arm.

qualifications.valuation: Output is annual domestic value added, expressed at a common local purchasing-power valuation. It is neither treasury cash nor foreign currency exchange. Local currencies remain distinct.
qualifications.uncertainty: Rounded staff estimates: national output and personnel commonly vary by about 15 percent; equipment and fragmented jurisdictions by 25 percent or more. No estimate guarantees an outcome.
qualifications.forces: Standing personnel include active services, permanent garrisons, cadres and obligated household troops once. Additional trained reserves exclude serving personnel and untrained population. Sustainable field strength is the standing-force portion supportable away from fixed defences over roughly ninety days on established supply routes; it includes support staff and is not all riflemen.
qualifications.equipment: Armour means serviceable tanks and armoured cars, not all military vehicles. Aircraft are combat, reconnaissance and maritime types, excluding trainers. Artillery excludes infantry mortars. Fleet displacement totals commissioned combat vessels including coastal and river craft, excluding merchant ships; tonnage alone does not establish fighting quality.
qualifications.technology: 1: basic local repair; 2: established older production; 3: mature current manufacture; 4: advanced specialist production; 5: leading reproducible practice. Ratings measure industrial depth, not access to every invention. Readiness, logistics and cohesion use 1 (weak) to 5 (exceptional).
qualifications.coverage: Food and fuel coverage compare normal domestic annual supply to normal domestic consumption; above 100 percent permits exports. These are not stored months of supply, and import partners or transport may fail. National food and fuel returns reconcile against planetary production. Fuel is coal-equivalent energy and food is grain-equivalent nourishment; these aggregates do not make fuel grades or foods interchangeable. Distribution losses and reserve replenishment absorb the modest global surplus.
qualifications.scope: Ossavren and smaller-jurisdiction entries are geographic sums across separate authorities, not united states. Cressault is already within Veyrasse population and resources; the disputed corridor has no additional national army or treasury. Serevask counts loyal districts only.
qualifications.updates: Return epoch matches the current census. Annual output trend describes ordinary net capacity change, not guaranteed growth. War, closures, purges, investment, losses and political changes require revised returns.
